{"text":"{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system appears to interpret past interactions as continuing interest in broadly related products or media, with insufficient attention to the specific purpose driving the next choice.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they extend a specific recurring preference, such as the same artist, holiday vocal style, or familiar musical era.",
    "Practical additions align when they serve a clear role alongside equipment or supplies already present in the user's history."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related items compete with stronger matches despite requiring unsupported equipment, projects, compatibility, or listening interests.",
    "Past ownership is treated as continuing demand even when a recent purchase may have already satisfied the need.",
    "Historical interests remain influential when recent interactions suggest a more specific current purpose, sound, or mood."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Broad category, ecosystem, genre, and surface wording similarities appear to substitute for a shared practical purpose or specific content preference.",
    "Previous purchases appear to support additional similar purchases without enough distinction between useful complements, replacements, and redundant items."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Repeated, specific themes in recent history provide stronger choice signals than general category membership.",
    "Compatibility, dimensions, quantities, equipment prerequisites, and complementary function determine whether related products are actually useful.",
    "Artist, era, intensity, arrangement, and seasonal intent distinguish immediately appealing media from merely plausible matches.",
    "Sparse or unidentified histories provide limited evidence of preference; skips involving unidentified items should remain uncertain rather than imply content rejection."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "The top recommendations contain too many broadly plausible associations whose immediate relevance is unsupported, diluting the specific matches users would choose now.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "The proportion of top-ranked items users would choose now, distinguished from items they merely consider related or potentially appealing.",
    "The frequency of top-ranked rejections attributed to unsupported tasks, incompatible specifications, redundant ownership, or mismatched media preferences.",
    "The ranking positions of items matching repeated recent interests relative to items sharing only broad categories or ecosystem associations.",
    "The proportion of uncertain judgments caused by unidentified histories or recommendations, tracked separately from explicit preference mismatches."
  ]
}"}
